request.style: English, male baritone solo, ethereal choir, piano, strings, cello, deep bass, atmospheric, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
By the river two figures stood
One on each bank where the waters flowed
One asked the man in linen
How long until the wonders cease
He raised his hands to heaven
Swearing by the one who lives forever

[Chorus]
A time times and half a time
Until the power of holy ones is broken
Sealed until the end
Many shall be purified and made clean

[Verse]
I heard but did not understand
Asked my lord for the outcome
The words are closed and sealed
Until the time of the end
The wicked shall act wickedly
None of them will understand

[Chorus]
A time times and half a time
Until the power of holy ones is broken
Sealed until the end
Many shall be purified and made clean

[Bridge]
Daily sacrifice taken away
Abomination of desolation set up
One thousand two hundred ninety days
Blessed is he who waits for thirteen thirty five

[Outro]
Go your way until the end
You will rest and rise for your portion
